flo-basel-s12-p3-en: Is an election invalid and null by law if made otherwise than prescribed, of a different kind of person, or by simony?
flo-florence-s12-p3-en: Does the council pursue the salvation, unity, and peace of the Christian people and the conservation of this holy ecumenical council?
flo-basel-s12-p4-en: When an election is presented for confirmation, must a co-elected person or objector be summoned by name to discuss the disputed election?
flo-florence-s12-p4-en: Is the Saviour working for the unity of the Christian people and his mystical body, with Ethiopian envoys expected to accept the orthodox faith in this council?
flo-basel-s12-p5-en: Should the supreme pontiff demand or accept nothing for confirming elections referred to him, lest notorious contraventions be delated to a future council?
flo-florence-s12-p5-en: Should further works for God’s praise and the increase of the faith receive careful attention, especially if the synod is held in a place of greater importance such as Rome?
flo-florence-s12-p6-en: Is the ecumenical council of Florence translated by apostolic authority to the Lateran basilica, to be resumed after entry into Rome?
flo-florence-s12-p7-en: With the appointed day come, do the reasons for resuming the council—extirpation of heresies, reform of morals, and the peace and increase of the Christian people—remain necessary?
flo-florence-s12-p8-en: Is the translated council of Florence resumed and continued in the Lateran patriarchate’s council hall, with those bound to attend required to come?
flo-florence-s12-p9-en: May anyone contravene this decree without the penalties reserved for those who disregard it?
flo-basel-s13-in-this-session-there-was-: Was an accusation of the pope’s contumacy read, Eugenius IV’s time-limit deferred, and a new decree for members’ protection approved?
flo-florence-s13-bull-of-union-with-the-: Is the orthodox faith being expanded as new peoples return to the obedience of the apostolic see, giving cause for joy to Christ’s faithful?
flo-florence-s13-p2-en: Has the Roman church’s profession of faith drawn Archbishop Abdala of Edessa, legate of the Syrian patriarch Ignatius, to petition for the rule of faith at this Lateran council?
flo-florence-s13-p3-en: Was Abdala found orthodox except on the Spirit’s procession, Christ’s two natures, and his two wills and principles of action?
flo-florence-s13-p4-en: Did Archbishop Abdala, once instructed, affirm that his doubts were answered and that he would accept the faith proposed with the council’s approval?
flo-florence-s13-p5-en: Did the fulfillment of the desire for that nation’s salvation fill the council with exultation and gratitude to God?
flo-florence-s13-p6-en: Was the faith and doctrine which the holy Roman mother church holds to be proposed to Archbishop Abdala to accept in the name of the Syrians?
flo-florence-s13-p7-en: Must Abdala accept that the holy Spirit proceeds eternally from the Father and the Son as from one principle and a single spiration?
flo-florence-s13-p8-en: Is one and the same Son of God and of man perfect in divinity and humanity, true God and true man, acknowledged in two natures without confusion, change, division, or separation?
flo-florence-s13-p9-en: Are there in the one Lord Jesus Christ two natural principles of action and two natural wills, the human subject to the divine, without division, change, separation, or confusion?
flo-florence-s13-p10-en: Must Archbishop Abdala accept this faith and embrace what the Roman church has defined, especially Florence’s decrees on the Greeks, Armenians, and Jacobites?
flo-basel-s14-in-this-session-there-was-: Was the monition to the pope deferred another ninety days, with proposals on revoking the council’s suspension and on Eugenius IV’s assent?
flo-florence-s14-bull-of-union-with-the-: Does God daily promote pastoral aims for the salvation of the Christian people with favours beyond desert?
flo-florence-s14-p2-en: After Florence’s eastern unions, was Archbishop Andrew of Kalocsa sent to Cyprus to confirm Greeks, Armenians, and Jacobites and bring others back to the faith?
flo-florence-s14-p3-en: Did Andrew work to eliminate Nestorius’s claim that Christ is only a man and Mary not Mother of God, and Macarius’s assertion of only one divine will in Christ?
flo-florence-s14-p4-en: Were Timothy, metropolitan of the Chaldeans, and Elias, bishop of the Maronites, with their peoples in Cyprus, converted to the orthodox faith delivered by Andrew?
flo-florence-s14-p5-en: Did Metropolitan Timothy make a solemn profession of the Roman church’s immaculate faith before the Lateran congregation?
flo-florence-s14-p6-en: Must all seven sacraments of the Roman church be confessed and approved just as she holds, teaches, and preaches?
flo-florence-s14-p7-en: Is oil never to be added in the sacred Eucharist?
flo-florence-s14-p8-en: Must one hold whatever the holy Roman church holds and reject especially the impieties of Nestorius and every heresy against the catholic church?
flo-florence-s14-p9-en: Must this professed faith be held and observed by subjects, with obstinate rejecters excommunicated, degraded, and handed to the secular arm?
flo-florence-s14-p10-en: Did Isaac, envoy of Bishop Elias of the Maronites, reject Macarius’s heresy of one will in Christ and make a similar profession?
flo-florence-s14-p11-en: Are the Chaldean metropolitan and Maronite bishop in Cyprus, with their subjects, received into the church’s bosom upon these professions while they remain in the faith?
flo-florence-s14-p12-en: May anyone call the Chaldean metropolitan, the Maronite bishop, or their peoples heretics or Nestorians, under pain of excommunication?
flo-florence-s14-p13-en: Are the said metropolitan and bishop and their successors to be preferred in honour to bishops separated from the communion of the holy Roman church?
flo-florence-s14-p14-en: May these prelates lay censures on their subjects, so that those they rightly excommunicate or absolve are held as such by all?
flo-florence-s14-p15-en: May these prelates and clerics freely celebrate divine services in Catholic churches, and Catholics in theirs?
flo-florence-s14-p16-en: May those who accept this union be buried in Catholic churches, marry Catholics in the Latin rite, and enjoy Catholic liberties in the realm?
flo-florence-s14-p17-en: Does the original Latin of this decree include the words “Mysterium Fidei,” as noted in Denzinger though omitted from Tanner?
flo-basel-s15-on-provincial-and-synodal-: Must an episcopal synod be held yearly in every diocese, as provincial councils and synods belong to the same cultivation as frequent general councils?
flo-basel-s15-p2-en: At a diocesan synod, should the word of God be expounded, provincial and synodal statutes read, and instruction given on administering the sacraments?
flo-basel-s15-p3-en: Must a provincial council be held in every province within two years after a general council and at least once every three years thereafter?
flo-basel-s15-p4-en: Should a provincial synod preceding a general council prepare matters for it and elect suitable persons to go in the province’s name?
flo-basel-s16-this-session-declares-the-: Did this session declare Pope Eugenius’s adherence to the council and incorporate Dudum sacrum with the three bulls it abrogated?
flo-basel-s17-on-the-admission-of-the-pr: Are Nicholas and Julian, cardinals, with the archbishop of Taranto, bishop of Padua, and abbot of St Justina, admitted as Eugenius IV’s presidents without coercive jurisdiction?
flo-basel-s18-on-the-renewal-of-the-decr: Does Basel renew Constance’s declaration on the authority of general councils, to which all are obliged to submit?
flo-basel-s19-on-the-agreement-between-t: Must holy mother church strive that all who go by the name of Christian guard in fraternal charity the unity of the faith, without which there can be no salvation?
flo-basel-s19-p2-en: Did the Greek emperor and patriarch of Constantinople send three outstanding envoys with a sufficient commission to pursue union with this synod?
flo-basel-s19-agreement-of-the-deputies-: Would the eastern church meet at its own expense in Constantinople if the western church agreed to hold the synod there?
flo-basel-s19-p4-en: Did the deputies and Greek ambassadors agree, subject to the council’s consent, that the emperor, patriarchs, and prelates would come to the synod with full power?
flo-basel-s19-p5-en: Must the western church pay the expenses of four large galleys to convey the emperor, patriarchs, and about seven hundred eastern persons to the council and back?
flo-basel-s19-p6-en: Shall Basel’s ambassadors name the landing port and place of the universal synod, striving that Basel be chosen, while Basel remains unless a legitimate impediment forces transfer?
flo-basel-s19-p7-en: Must the agreed clauses be fulfilled by both parties under decree and seal, with the supreme pontiff’s express consent by patent bulls once all is confirmed?
flo-basel-s19-p8-en: Did the Greek ambassadors explain a “universal synod” as requiring the pope and patriarchs present in person or by procurators, free and without quarrelsome contention?
flo-basel-s19-p9-en: Does this holy synod approve and ratify the above union clauses and seek Eugenius IV’s express consent lest so great a good be lost?
flo-basel-s19-decree-on-jews-and-neophyt: Must diocesan bishops depute persons well trained in scripture to preach several times a year where Jews and other infidels live, that they may be converted to the orthodox faith?
flo-basel-s19-p11-en: Must Vienne’s constitution providing university teachers of Hebrew, Arabic, Greek, and Chaldean be faithfully observed, with adequate recompense for those teachers?
flo-basel-s19-p12-en: Are Jews and other infidels forbidden to have Christians in their households or service, and Christians forbidden to join them in festivities, marriages, banquets, or baths?
flo-basel-s19-about-those-who-desire-con: If someone converts to the catholic faith, do his movable and immovable goods remain intact, except that goods from usury require restitution when the persons owed are known?
flo-basel-s19-p14-en: Should converts by baptism enjoy the privileges of the cities where they are regenerated, and be carefully instructed in the articles of faith and catholic ceremonies?
flo-basel-s19-p15-en: Should provincial councils remedy negligent bishops and converts who return as Judaizers, proceeding against the obstinate as against perfidious heretics?
flo-basel-s20-decree-on-concubinaries-en: Were authentic texts of Basel’s constitutions on concubinaries, issued 22 January 1435, to be extracted from the acts for judicial and extra-judicial use?
flo-basel-s20-p2-en: Is a cleric of any dignity who persists as a public concubinary after notice automatically suspended for three months from the fruits of all his benefices?
flo-basel-s20-p3-en: May ecclesiastical judges accept bribes from concubinaries to tolerate their conduct, or must prelates segregate such women from their subjects?
flo-basel-s20-excommunicates-are-not-to-: Must one abstain from communion with someone only when an ecclesiastical sentence is specifically promulgated against a named person, college, church, or place?
flo-basel-s20-interdicts-are-not-to-be-i: May a city or place be laid under interdict only by reason of the place itself or its lords or governors, not merely for the fault of a private person?
flo-basel-s20-p6-en: Is a second appeal forbidden on the same complaint or from the same interlocutory sentence lacking final force, with frivolous appellants fined fifteen gold florins?
flo-basel-s21-on-annates-en: Is nothing whatsoever henceforth to be paid in the Roman curia or elsewhere for confirmations, collations, elections, sacred orders, blessings, or pallia?
flo-basel-s21-about-those-in-peaceful-po: Is one who has held a prelacy, dignity, benefice, or office peacefully for three years with a specious title protected from later disturbance of his claim?
flo-basel-s21-how-the-divine-office-is-t: Must the divine praises in cathedral and collegiate churches be celebrated reverently, gravely, and slowly, with reasonable pauses, especially mid-verse in the psalms?
flo-basel-s21-the-times-at-which-each-on: Is one absent from an hour who is not present at matins before the end of Venite, at other hours before the first psalm’s end, or at mass before the last Kyrie?
flo-basel-s21-how-the-canonical-hours-sh: Must benefice-holders and those in holy orders recite the day and night offices reverently and distinctly, not mumbled, abbreviated, or mixed with conversation?
flo-basel-s21-about-those-who-wander-abo: Does a benefice-holder who wanders or chats during divine services automatically forfeit attendance for that hour and the whole day?
flo-basel-s21-about-a-notice-board-hangi: Must a notice-board hang permanently in the choir listing each canon’s reading or singing duties, with forfeiture of a day’s stipend for failure?
flo-basel-s21-on-those-who-at-mass-do-no: Must abuses cease whereby the Creed is not sung to the end, secular songs are sung, masses lack a server, or secret prayers are said too low to be heard?
flo-basel-s21-about-those-who-pledge-div: Is a canon’s pledge to cease divine services if debts are unpaid null even if sworn, with three months’ revenues lost for such illicit agreements?
flo-basel-s21-on-holding-chapters-at-the: Are chapters and meetings of canons forbidden at the same time as the principal mass, especially on solemn feasts, save for sudden urgent necessity?
flo-basel-s21-on-not-performing-spectacl: Are scandalous practices such as the feast of fools, masked comedies, dances, and banquets in churches forbidden under pain of three months’ loss of revenues?
flo-basel-s22-on-the-condemnation-of-the: Does this holy synod condemn and censure the book of master Augustine, archbishop of Nazareth, as harming the purity of the Christian faith?
flo-basel-s22-p2-en: Is the assertion that “Christ sins daily,” even if referred only to his members, scandalous and erroneous in the faith, along with related Constance-condemned articles?
flo-basel-s22-p3-en: Are those propositions and others from the same root in Augustine’s book condemned as erroneous, so that teaching or defending them is punished as heresy?
flo-basel-s23-on-the-election-of-the-sup: Does Basel renew and add to prior constitutions on electing the Roman pontiff so that the supreme shepherd may provide for the salvation of souls?
flo-basel-s23-p2-en: Must cardinals in conclave, after a mass of the holy Spirit, swear to elect as pontiff the person they think beneficial to the universal church, not one seeking election by gifts?
flo-basel-s23-on-the-profession-of-the-s: Must the person elected pope express consent in the prescribed manner within a day of demand, or is the election annulled and a new election required?
flo-basel-s23-form-of-consent-en: Must the elected pope profess that he will firmly believe the catholic faith according to the apostles, general councils, and especially the eight holy universal councils?
flo-basel-s23-p5-en: Must the first cardinal present annually remind the pope on his election or coronation anniversary of the promise made to God on the day of his election?
flo-basel-s23-p6-en: After coronation and yearly after election, must the pope discuss with his brethren for at least eight days how to carry out his solemn promises, beginning with persecuted regions?
flo-basel-s23-p7-en: After universal affairs, must the pope reform his house, household, and the Roman curia so that lesser churches may draw purity of morals from the head?
flo-basel-s23-p8-en: Must the pope ensure that lands of the Roman church are justly and peacefully ruled with paternal charity, not for gain, removing factions such as Guelphs and Ghibellines?
flo-basel-s23-p9-en: Must the pope inquire how his legates and governors rule, and not tolerate tyrannical taxes or unjust burdens on the church’s subjects?
flo-basel-s23-p10-en: By Nicholas IV’s constitution, does half of the fruits and taxes from lands of the Roman church belong to the cardinals, with governors appointed by their advice?
flo-basel-s23-p11-en: Must the supreme pontiff, calling himself servant of the servants of God, give easy access and hold at least one public audience weekly, especially for the poor?
flo-basel-s23-on-the-number-and-qualitie: Should cardinals be appointed in a number not burdensome or cheapened by excess, chosen from the regions of Christianity as far as convenient?
flo-basel-s23-p13-en: May nephews of the living pope or of a living cardinal, bastards, the physically handicapped, or those of criminal reputation be made cardinals?
flo-basel-s23-p14-en: Must a newly chosen cardinal swear fidelity to blessed Peter, the Roman church, and the pope, and labour for the defense of the catholic faith and eradication of heresies?
flo-basel-s23-p15-en: Must a tenth of each cardinal’s share of Roman-church revenues be applied yearly to his titular church, with enough left for one person’s upkeep?
flo-basel-s23-p16-en: Should cardinal-bishops inquire into heresies, cardinal-priests into lax morals, and cardinal-deacons into wars among princes, promoting these works with the pope?
flo-basel-s23-p17-en: Must cardinals treat visitors kindly without favouritism as collateral judges or biased protectors of princes or communities?
flo-basel-s23-p18-en: Should the household, table, furniture, and horses of pope and cardinals be moderate and free from excess, following Gregory’s constitution on a pastor’s example?
flo-basel-s23-p19-en: Should only greater cases such as elections to cathedrals or matters of princes be assigned to cardinals, with lesser cases sent to the Rota?
flo-basel-s23-on-elections-en: With general reservations of elective churches abolished, may the Roman pontiff attempt special reservations against free elections only for an important reason stated in detail?
flo-basel-s23-on-reservations-en: Does this synod abolish general and special papal reservations of churches and benefices introduced by Ad regimen, Execrabilis, or chancery rules, except those in the corpus of law?
flo-basel-s23-p22-en: Does this paragraph address the Clementine “Letters”?
flo-basel-s23-p23-en: Do apostolic letters alleging renunciation or deprivation prejudice someone’s rights unless proved by witnesses or other legitimate documents?
flo-basel-s24-about-business-with-the-gr: Must the terms for a universal council of both churches, already signed, be presented under the council’s leaden seal to the emperor and patriarch at Constantinople?
flo-basel-s24-p2-en: Is union of the western and eastern churches the chief work among those for which this holy council assembled?
flo-basel-s24-safe-conduct-for-the-greek: Does Basel grant the Greek emperor and patriarch a safe-conduct for the coming universal synod so that suspicion as to their security and freedom may be removed?
flo-basel-s24-p4-en: May the Greeks freely go out and return from the council place with their goods, and be taken back to Constantinople at western expense even if union fails?
flo-basel-s24-p5-en: Does this safe-conduct stand notwithstanding differences, judgments, or crimes between the western and eastern churches?
flo-basel-s24-p6-en: Must western prelates, kings, and communities honour and favour the emperor, patriarch, and their company going to and from the council?
flo-basel-s25-on-the-places-for-the-futu: Has Basel devoted itself to healing the long division between eastern and western churches over the profession of the same faith?
flo-basel-s25-p2-en: Did the Greeks send solemn envoys with the emperor’s golden seal and the patriarch’s leaden seal, leading to mutually agreed terms for union?
flo-basel-s25-p3-en: Ought the future ecumenical council to be held at Basel or, if rejected, at Avignon or otherwise in Savoy, according to the agreement with the Greeks?
flo-basel-s25-p4-en: Did Basel from its outset send envoys to Constantinople to promote union, who returned with ambassadors of the emperor of the Romans?
flo-basel-s25-p5-en: With the time-limit imminent, should Florence or Udine—or another safe place named in the decree convenient for pope and Greeks—be chosen for the ecumenical council?
flo-ferrara-s31-ecclesiastical-penalties: Must nefarious excesses of those who disturb the church’s peace and overturn the barque of Peter be repressed with due retribution?
flo-ferrara-s31-p2-en: Did some at Basel choose Avignon against the Greek ambassadors’ protest that the emperor and patriarch would not come unless the pope attended in person?
flo-ferrara-s31-p3-en: Did Eugenius, with the cardinals’ assent, translate the council of Basel to Ferrara as suitable for the Greeks and for the apostolic see?
flo-ferrara-s31-p4-en: Was the translation to Ferrara declared made from necessity, with conditions regularized, so that the council at Ferrara ought to begin and continue?
flo-ferrara-s31-p5-en: Was Cardinal Nicholas of holy Cross sent as legate to open the council at Ferrara?
flo-ferrara-s31-p6-en: Did the Ferrara council declare the translation and declaration legitimate, just, and made from urgent necessity for union and to avoid a split?
flo-ferrara-s31-p7-en: Did Eugenius come to Ferrara when the emperor, patriarch, and Greeks approached Italy, intending to pursue union and Basel’s original objectives?
flo-ferrara-s31-p8-en: Did Cardinal Julian urge those remaining at Basel to withdraw from scandal, then depart when they persevered in hardness of heart despite the Greeks’ approach to Italy?
flo-ferrara-s31-p9-en: Must justice be decreed against the remnant at Basel whose excesses impede and destroy the desired union with the Greeks?
flo-ferrara-s31-p10-en: Have those still meeting at Basel under a pretended council already incurred excommunication, privation of dignities, and disqualification from benefices?
flo-ferrara-s31-p11-en: Is whatever attempted at Basel in the name of a council since the translation null and void against those who follow the curia or the Ferrara council?
flo-ferrara-s31-p12-en: Must all meeting at Basel under pretext of a council leave that city within thirty days, and must Basel’s magistrates expel those who remain?
flo-ferrara-s31-p13-en: Do Basel’s rulers and the city automatically incur excommunication and interdict if they fail to expel the remnant within thirty days?
flo-ferrara-s31-p14-en: Must merchants who came to Basel for the former council depart under pain of excommunication, with goods of obstinate suppliers open to spoliation by the faithful?
flo-ferrara-s31-p15-en: If those at Basel repent and depart within thirty days, are the penalties remitted and cancelled as for obedient sons?
flo-ferrara-s42-eugenius-iv-and-the-fath: Are western and eastern peoples, long separated, hastening to enter a pact of harmony and unity under God’s mercies to his church?
flo-ferrara-s42-p2-en: Is it the duty of the pope and the whole church to strain every nerve so that these initiatives of union progress and they may be co-operators with God?
flo-ferrara-s42-p3-en: Did Emperor John Palaeologus declare he could not go to Basel and require those assembled there to come to Ferrara for the work of holy union?
flo-ferrara-s42-p4-en: Does Eugenius intend to carry out Basel’s decree agreed by the Greeks, the choice of place later confirmed at Bologna, and other things pertaining to union?
flo-ferrara-s42-p5-en: With the assent of emperor, patriarch, and the present synod, does there exist a free and safe holy universal synod in Ferrara for the business of union?
trent-s1-decree-touching-the-opening-of-: Was it decreed that the sacred and general council of Trent begin, unto the praise of the Trinity, the increase of the faith, the extirpation of heresies, and the reformation of clergy and people?
trent-s1-indiction-of-the-next-session-e: Was the first ensuing session of Trent indicted for the Thursday after Epiphany, 7 January 1546?
trent-s2-decree-touching-the-manner-of-l: Are all the faithful assembled at Trent exhorted to amend their sins, since every perfect gift is from above and the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom?
trent-s2-indiction-of-the-next-session-e: Was the next session of Trent indicted for Thursday, the fourth of the ensuing February?
trent-s3-symbol-of-faith-decree-en: Does Trent, assembled for extirpating heresies and reforming manners, exhort all to be strengthened in the Lord against the spirits of wickedness?
trent-s4-edition-use-sacred-books-decree: Is the old Vulgate Latin edition to be held authentic in public lectures, disputations, sermons, and expositions, with none daring to reject it?
trent-s5-original-sin-canon2-en: Did Adam’s prevarication injure only himself and not his posterity, transfusing death into the race but not sin, the death of the soul?
trent-s5-original-sin-canon3-en: Can Adam’s sin, transfused by propagation, be taken away by human nature’s powers or by any remedy other than the merit of Christ applied in baptism?
trent-s5-original-sin-canon4-en: Must newly born infants, even of baptized parents, be baptized because they derive original sin from Adam needing expiation by regeneration?
trent-s5-original-sin-canon5-en: By the grace conferred in baptism, is the guilt of original sin remitted so that the whole of that which has the true nature of sin is taken away, not merely rased or not imputed?
trent-s5-original-sin-decree-en: Does Trent reclaim those in error on original sin and its remedy so that the Catholic faith may continue in perfect integrity?
trent-s6-justification-canon1-en: Can a man be justified before God by his own works, whether of nature or of the law, without the grace of God through Jesus Christ?
trent-s6-justification-canon2-en: Is the grace of God through Jesus Christ given only so that man may more easily live justly and merit eternal life, as if free will without grace could do both?
trent-s6-justification-canon3-en: Without the prevenient inspiration and help of the Holy Ghost, can man believe, hope, love, or be penitent as he ought so as to receive the grace of Justification?
trent-s6-justification-canon5-en: Since Adam’s sin, is the free will of man lost and extinguished, a mere name without reality and a figment introduced by Satan?
trent-s6-justification-canon6-en: Is it not in man’s power to make his ways evil, God working evil works properly of Himself as much as good, so that Judas’s treason is no less His work than Paul’s vocation?
trent-s6-justification-canon7-en: Are all works done before Justification truly sins that merit God’s hatred, so that the more earnestly one disposes himself for grace the more grievously he sins?
trent-s6-justification-canon8-en: Is the fear of hell—whereby we grieve for sins and flee to God’s mercy—itself a sin, or does it make sinners worse?
trent-s6-justification-canon9-en: Is the impious justified by faith alone, so that nothing else is required to co-operate and no preparation by the movement of his own will is necessary?
trent-s6-justification-canon10-en: Are men just without the justice of Christ whereby He merited that we be justified, or formally just by that justice itself alone?
trent-s6-justification-canon11-en: Are men justified by the sole imputation of Christ’s justice or sole remission of sins, excluding the grace and charity poured forth by the Holy Ghost and inherent in them?
trent-s6-justification-canon12-en: Is justifying faith nothing else but confidence in the divine mercy that remits sins for Christ’s sake, and is that confidence alone that whereby we are justified?
trent-s6-justification-canon13-en: Must everyone, to obtain remission of sins, believe for certain and without any wavering that his sins are forgiven him?
trent-s6-justification-canon14-en: Is a man truly absolved and justified because he assuredly believed himself so, or is no one truly justified but he who believes himself justified?
trent-s6-justification-canon15-en: Is a man born again and justified bound of faith to believe that he is assuredly in the number of the predestinate?
trent-s6-justification-canon16-en: May one say with absolute and infallible certainty that he will have the gift of perseverance unto the end, unless he has learned this by special revelation?
trent-s6-justification-canon17-en: Is the grace of Justification attained only by those predestined unto life, while others called receive no grace as predestined unto evil?
trent-s6-justification-canon18-en: Are the commandments of God impossible to keep even for one that is justified and constituted in grace?
trent-s6-justification-canon19-en: Is nothing besides faith commanded in the Gospel, other things being indifferent, or do the ten commandments nowise appertain to Christians?
trent-s6-justification-canon20-en: Is the justified man, however perfect, bound only to believe and not to observe the commandments of God and of the Church?
trent-s6-justification-canon21-en: Was Christ Jesus given of God only as a redeemer in whom to trust, and not also as a legislator whom to obey?
trent-s6-justification-canon22-en: Can the justified persevere in the justice received without the special help of God, or is he unable to persevere even with that help?
trent-s6-justification-canon23-en: Can a man once justified sin no more nor lose grace, or avoid all sins even venial for life except by a special privilege as the Church holds of the Blessed Virgin?
trent-s6-justification-canon24-en: Is the justice received preserved and increased before God through good works, or are those works merely fruits and signs and not a cause of its increase?
trent-s6-justification-canon25-en: In every good work does the just sin at least venially, or even mortally, escaping damnation only because God does not impute those works unto damnation?
trent-s6-justification-canon26-en: Ought the just, for good works done in God, to expect an eternal recompense through God’s mercy and Christ’s merit if they persevere in well doing?
trent-s6-justification-canon27-en: Is there no mortal sin but infidelity, so that grace once received is lost by no other sin however grievous?
trent-s6-justification-canon28-en: When grace is lost through sin, is faith always lost with it, or is faith remaining without charity not true faith, so that one with faith without charity is not a Christian?
trent-s6-justification-canon29-en: Can one who has fallen after baptism rise again by God’s grace, or recover lost justice by faith alone without the sacrament of Penance?
trent-s6-justification-canon30-en: After Justification, is every penitent’s guilt remitted and eternal punishment blotted out so that no debt of temporal punishment remains in this world or in Purgatory?
trent-s6-justification-canon31-en: Does the justified sin when he performs good works with a view to an eternal recompense?
trent-s6-justification-canon32-en: Are the good works of the justified also his good merits, truly meriting increase of grace, eternal life, and increase of glory if he departs in grace?
trent-s6-justification-canon33-en: Does the Catholic doctrine of Justification set forth by this Synod derogate from the glory of God or the merits of Christ, rather than render them more illustrious?
trent-s6-justification-ch1-en: After Adam’s fall, were men so under sin, the devil, and death that neither Gentiles by nature nor Jews by the letter of Moses’ law could be liberated thereby?
trent-s6-justification-ch10-en: Do the justified, through observance of the commandments with faith co-operating with good works, increase in the justice received through the grace of Christ?
trent-s6-justification-ch11-en: Must even the justified observe the commandments, which are not impossible, since God by commanding admonishes us to do what we can and to pray for what we cannot?
trent-s6-justification-ch12-en: May anyone in this mortal life presume to determine for certain that he is assuredly among the predestinate, except by special revelation?
trent-s6-justification-ch13-en: Though all should place firm hope in God’s help, may anyone promise himself the gift of perseverance with absolute certainty?
trent-s6-justification-ch14-en: May those who have fallen from Justification by sin be again justified through the sacrament of Penance, which the Fathers call a second plank after shipwreck?
trent-s6-justification-ch15-en: Is the grace of Justification lost not only by infidelity but by any mortal sin, even when faith itself is not lost?
trent-s6-justification-ch16-en: Are eternal life and increase of glory to be proposed to the justified both as a grace mercifully promised and as a reward for good works done in God?
trent-s6-justification-ch2-en: Did the Father send his Son Jesus Christ in the fullness of time as a propitiator through faith in his blood, to redeem Jews under the Law and grant Gentiles the adoption of sons?
trent-s6-justification-ch3-en: Though Christ died for all, do only those receive the benefit of his death unto whom the merit of his passion is communicated by being born again in him?
trent-s6-justification-ch4-en: Is Justification of the impious a translation from Adam’s state to the state of grace and adoption through Christ, which since the Gospel cannot be without the laver of regeneration or its desire?
trent-s6-justification-ch5-en: In adults, does Justification begin from God’s prevenient grace through Christ, so that they freely assent to and co-operate with that grace?
trent-s6-justification-ch6-en: Are adults disposed to Justification when, excited by grace, they believe what God has revealed, turn from fear to hope in his mercy, and begin to love him as the fountain of all justice?
trent-s6-justification-ch7-en: Is Justification not remission of sins merely, but also sanctification and renewal of the inward man through voluntary reception of grace and gifts?
trent-s6-justification-ch8-en: Are we said to be justified by faith because faith is the beginning and root of Justification, and freely because nothing preceding it—faith or works—merits the grace of Justification?
trent-s6-justification-ch9-en: Though sins are remitted only gratuitously by God’s mercy for Christ’s sake, may anyone rest on a vain confidence and certainty of remission alone, as heretics preach?
trent-s6-justification-proem-en: Does Trent purpose to set forth the true Catholic doctrine of Justification against an erroneous teaching then disseminated to the shipwreck of many souls?
trent-s7-baptism-canon1-en: Did the baptism of John have the same force as the baptism of Christ?
trent-s7-confirmation-canon1-en: Is confirmation of the baptized an idle ceremony rather than a true and proper sacrament, or formerly only a kind of catechism for adolescents?
trent-s7-baptism-canon2-en: Is true and natural water of necessity for baptism, or may our Lord’s words “born again of water and the Holy Ghost” be taken as mere metaphor?
trent-s7-confirmation-canon2-en: Do those who ascribe any virtue to the sacred chrism of confirmation offer an outrage to the Holy Ghost?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon2-en: Do the sacraments of the New Law differ from those of the Old Law only in ceremonies and outward rites?
